description: This file is a test suite for utility functions related to credits calculation, including conversion from USD to credits, environment variable handling, and shape validation for project and user data objects.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Retrieve the number of credits per USD from environment variables, defaulting to 20000 if unset.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Convert a USD amount to credits based on the current credits-per-USD rate, handling rounding and invalid inputs.
